title: Spells carry power and toughness values in printed.json that the cards do not print
summary: Spells print no stats (stats mark a unit, Rulebook 2023 p.3), but the oracle transcription has power and toughness fields on spell rows and the extractor copies them: 91 of 138 spells in printed.json have non-zero values (Arc Lightning 1/3, Spectrogenesis 4/5, Interdiction Rift 4/3 in the oracle). Suspected harmless; check that no engine or UI path reads a spell's power or toughness (an "Everything is Deadly" reach onto spells, a copy of a spell, Unaware reading printed stats, a card-stats or search surface). If none does, zero them at extraction so nothing can start to.

evidence.quote: CR 206.2 / CT-244: no spell in the engine pool or the catalogue carries power or toughness

closed: fixed on 2026-10-22 (CT-244): spells and spell tokens are zeroed at extraction, and stat searches leave spells out (ui 565, 567).

title: 393-raq-mods Borrower/Reconfigure test is vacuous: Reconfigure is never castable in its setup
summary: The test guards the RAQ answer that a Borrower of Forms that copied an [Augment] unit is not a first target of Reconfigure, but wraps every assertion in `if (legalActions(...) offers Reconfigure)`. The verifier measured that branch as never taken with the test own setup (no real [Augment] unit is available as a first target, so Reconfigure is not castable), so the test asserts nothing. Add a real [Augment] unit to the setup and drop the `if`, so the play is required and the refusal is asserted; a verifier probe (not committed) did exactly that and passed.

evidence.quote: assert.ok(first.includes(bubb2), 'positive control: the real [Augment] unit is offered');

closed: fixed on 2026-10-24 (CT-240): a real [Augment] unit makes Reconfigure castable, and the test asserts it is, with a positive control.
